user_prompt: Is the core idea of this paper novel relative to the related work I gave you?
scope: The target paper target/paper.txt (arXiv:2005.11401, RAG) and the supplied corpus of 10 real related-paper abstracts under corpus/, searched by search_repo and read by inspect_file; the novelty question is scoped to the target's STATED contribution and to subsumption BY THE SUPPLIED CORPUS ONLY (not the open literature).

claims.text: The target paper's stated contribution is identifiable from the supplied text (a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe combining a pre-trained seq2seq generator with a pre-trained neural dense retriever over a non-parametric Wikipedia index, for open-ended language generation).
The contribution is identified (C1) and the closest work in the supplied corpus has been located by search and inspected.

Under the supplied corpus and the declared search protocol, no inspected corpus item subsumes the target's stated contribution (a jointly fine-tuned seq2seq generator conditioned on passages from a dense neural retriever, marginalizing over retrieved documents to produce open-ended generation, not just extractive answers): the contribution stands as novel relative to this corpus.

atoms.proposition: The target's contribution paragraph is read via inspect_file over target/paper.txt.
The corpus is searched for the mechanism family with search_repo (pattern retriev|non-parametric|dense over corpus/), returning at least one match.
The closest retriever-only corpus candidate (Dense Passage Retrieval, arXiv:2004.04906) is read via inspect_file.
The closest retrieval-augmented-pretraining corpus candidate (REALM, arXiv:2002.08909) is read via inspect_file.
Expert adjudication is obtained (ask_user) on whether any inspected corpus abstract claims the target's specific mechanism; the adjudication is that none does.

notes_for_annotators: Target arXiv:2005.11401 (RAG, Lewis et al. 2020), corpus of 10 real abstracts, all fetched 2026-07-29 from arxiv.org abs pages (provenance in artifacts/res-rag/PROVENANCE). ADJUDICATION (E5 answer, verified by reading the abstracts): No corpus item subsumes the target's stated contribution. The target's contribution is a GENERATIVE recipe: a pre-trained seq2seq model (generator) conditioned on top-k passages from a pre-trained dense retriever over a Wikipedia index, fine-tuned END-TO-END and marginalizing over retrieved documents to produce open-ended, factual language GENERATION (not just extraction), applied broadly across knowledge-intensive NLP tasks. The closest corpus items differ in mechanism: Dense Passage Retrieval (2004.04906, predates RAG by ~6 weeks) is RETRIEVAL ONLY -- its abstract describes a dual-encoder retriever paired with a separate extractive/reader QA system, with no generative seq2seq marginalization over passages and no claim to general-purpose language generation; REALM (2002.08909, predates RAG by ~3 months) augments MASKED LANGUAGE MODEL PRETRAINING with a latent retriever trained via backprop through retrieval for the MLM objective, evaluated by fine-tuning for extractive open-domain QA -- a pretraining-time retrieval mechanism for a different (cloze-style) objective, not a general-purpose generation fine-tuning recipe. BART (1910.13461) and T5 (1910.10683) are the generator backbones (no retrieval component); kNN-LM (1911.00172) interpolates a token-level nearest-neighbor datastore into an LM's output distribution, a different non-parametric mechanism (no learned dense retriever, no passage-level generation conditioning); FiD (2007.01282) postdates the target (July 2020 vs May 2020) and is itself a follow-up. Route minimality: E1 necessary (cannot judge novelty without reading the contribution); E2 necessary (the corpus must actually be searched, not assumed); E3, E4 necessary (the two nearest candidates must be read, not inferred from titles); E5 necessary (the subsumption call is the adjudicated conclusion). Order-coherence by containment. Decoy citation_count_lookup is not a listed action. The answer the ask_user tool returns is this note; E5 attests that the adjudication was obtained.
